note: What a server sends to change how a spell already in a unit's slot is aimed. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot. A champion's own spells count from 0.

bits.name: summonerSlots
bits.note: Set where the slot counts among the summoner slots, so that 0 and 1 name those two.

fields.name: targeting
fields.note: How the spell is aimed, 0 to 7. A client keeps a larger value and reports it as an error, but builds no new aiming for it, so the slot keeps the aiming it had; no value asks for the spell's own default.
